scene: Inside the loud paper mill, three distinct transit bays await passengers.
picture: Side-view pixel art of a bustling factory floor. Left, a striped water taxi bobs in an indoor canal slipway. Centre-left, the elderly East Asian man in blue cap and orange cardigan stands holding his cane. Up high, an electric monorail door sits open. Far right, a red funicular railway car sits on steel rails.
shown: a striped canal water taxi moored at a wooden slipway on the left
a sleek yellow monorail car idling at an elevated platform up high
a red angled funicular railway car waiting at a ramp on the far right
